11081|cb7eee8e.name: Faldron
11081|cb7eee8e.text: Many animals lost their lives so that we could gain these materials. Do not take their sacrifice lightly, $N. Handle the leather with the respect it deserves.

11866|f3b1497b.name: Ilyenia Moonfire
11866|f3b1497b.text: The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

4210|0c543544.name: Alegorn
4210|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4211|a28d29e1.name: Dannelor
4211|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4262|ce424d00.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

156-accept.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-accept.text:
If you bring me some rot blossoms then I can brew you up a batch of zombie juice.

Rot blossoms grow in strange places.  In particular, I hear you can find them inside the skulls of Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends... not that I've gotten close enough to look!

The Raven Hill Cemetery and the Tranquil Gardens are both lousy with those skeletons.  You may as well get rid of them while you're looking for rot blossoms.  The town of Darkshire would be grateful.
156-accept.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

158-complete.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
158-complete.text: You need some Zombie Juice, do you?  Hmm...that's some strong stuff - I don't usually get requests for it.
158-complete.title: Zombie Juice

173-accept.name: Calor
173-accept.text:
Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.

You believe yourself worthy to join us?

I once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.

Test your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.
173-accept.title: Worgen in the Woods

343-accept.name: Brother Kristoff
343-accept.text:
I'm giving a speech on the Fortitude of the Spirit, and I'd like to recite passages from a particular book on metallurgy - "The Stresses of Iron."  A copy of this book should be in the Royal Library, within Stormwind Keep.  Can you retrieve it for me?  If so, then may the blessings of the Light be with you!

The Royal Library is very large, but the head librarian, Milton Sheaf, knows each shelf like it was his own son.  Speak to him, he'll retrieve the book for you.
343-accept.title: Speaking of Fortitude

343-complete.name: Milton Sheaf
343-complete.text: Metallurgy?  Ah yes, we have many books on the subject, and are happy to aid Brother Kristoff with his speech!  Now...which particular book was it the good brother needed?
343-complete.title: Speaking of Fortitude

344-accept.name: Milton Sheaf
344-accept.text:
The Stresses of Iron?  Yes, I know the book.  Quite a good one, written by the Dwarven miner Margulf Blaggon a few decades ago.  He spent most his time deep in the mountains of Khaz Modan, digging ore.  Smart fellow!

But where was I?  Oh yes, the Stresses of Iron!  I'm afraid the book was moved to the Northshire Abbey.  The caretaker of the Abbey's library, Brother Paxton, wanted to make a copy of the book for his own shelves.

But that was months ago.  I wonder why it's taking him so long...
344-accept.title: Brother Paxton

57-complete.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
57-complete.text: The people of Darkshire thank you, $N.  You have proven yourself to be a great ally of The Night Watch.
57-complete.title: The Night Watch

58-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
58-accept.text: The situation in Raven Hill is still grim.  The safety of Darkshire is in your hands, $N.  I don't have enough Watchers to keep the town safe.  We need you to dispatch for Raven Hill yet again and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders!
58-accept.title: The Night Watch

98190-complete.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98190-complete.text: You have my gratitude for recovering this. I am relieved it did not fall into the wrong hands.
98190-complete.title: A Friend of the Family

98190-progress.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98190-progress.text: Let us speak, $c. I can feel you carry something of the Light.
98190-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-accept.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98191-accept.text:
King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.

The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathedral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
98191-accept.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-complete.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-complete.text:
By the Light... it looks just like his boy...

<Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker pauses for a moment.>

This statuette has indeed been blessed. Its connection to Terenas, its survival of what that monster did to him... this carries great power for those who believe in its strength.

It is best kept here for now, under guard of the paladin order. We will meditate on it further to learn more of its gifts, and perhaps it may aid us in dark times ahead.

Thank you, $c. Light bless you.
98191-complete.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-progress.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-progress.text: Light be with you, $c. You are clearly not here for small talk--what is it?
98191-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98219-accept.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98219-accept.text:
Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, $N.

I could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

His father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.

There is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.
98219-accept.title: The Shamed Lieutenant
